name: c3-watchdog
description: c3-watchdog — the machine sampler. Publishes one JSON snapshot of cpu, memory, swap, storage, cgroup slices, PSI, network and the process table, and owns the guarded kill/restart mailbox. Its own systray; my-konsole and my-konsole-dash are consumers.

build._remote_note: Rust compile is heavy — built on GHA, published to the rolling GitHub Release, fetched by the desktop nix module. Never compiled locally (freeze-guard).

runtime._path_note: The published paths keep the my-konsole- prefix on purpose. They are a contract with every consumer already reading them — the panel, the dash, the QML widget — and renaming a file to match a repo layout would break all of them to no benefit.
